notes: BuyGateHook governs one native ETH/SURF pool, with ETH as currency0 and SurfToken as currency1. Initial sqrtPriceX96 is 2^96, choosing the 1:1 raw-unit ratio used in the repository's pool tests. beforeInitialize accepts only fee 3000 and tick spacing 60 with native ETH, binds the first pool, records the calling router as initializer (for reference only, it grants no rights), sets genesis and marks the rest of that transaction in transient storage as the initialization transaction; subsequent initialization is refused. All enabled callbacks require the configured PoolManager. The hook address must encode these permissions (10432 / 0x28C0); the constructor refuses any other address. Buys exchange ETH for SURF and are always permitted by the hook. Sells are otherwise closed. Days are 86400 seconds from genesis, not UTC midnight. Holders approve and deposit SURF, then vote once per address per day with their deposited balance at vote time; voting locks withdrawals until that day ends. A vote is refused while the PoolManager is unlocked, so the quorum snapshot cannot be moved by a flash take. The implementation interprets the voting requirement as both yes > no and yes + no >= quorum. Quorum is floor(5% of circulating supply), snapshotted at the day's first vote; circulating supply is totalSupply minus the PoolManager's SURF balance. No votes or a tie fails. A passing day d vote opens sells only during the first 3600 seconds of day d+1; day 0 has no sell window. The aggregate sell allowance is floor(50% of the previous day's actual SURF buy output), shared first come, first served. Unused allowance does not carry over; current-day buys count toward the next day. beforeSwap gates sells and rejects exact-input amounts above the remaining allowance. afterSwap records actual buy output and sell input and reverts any sell exceeding the cap, including exact-output sells. Deposits and withdrawals do not count as swaps. Liquidity belongs to the launch alone: a single-sided SURF position is a resting sell order that any buy fills, and buying from one's own position would inflate the recorded buys. beforeAddLiquidity accepts a position only in the transaction that initialized the pool (any router, any number of positions) or as the pool's first position ever; every other add reverts with LiquidityNotFromLaunch, whoever sends it and through whatever router, the one that called initialize included. The sender argument is never trusted because it names a router whose users cannot be told apart. The factory must therefore deploy the hook, initialize the pool and seed the whole liquidity in one transaction: there is no later add path for anyone, and a seed sent in a later transaction is exposed to a front-runner's dust position that would leave the pool unseedable. Removing liquidity is not restricted, but removed liquidity cannot be put back. The hook charges no fee, overrides no LP fee, and returns zero swap deltas; all return-delta permissions are disabled. The ordinary 0.3% pool LP fee goes to liquidity providers. Nothing is routed to surfsurf.eth. No administrator, parameter setters, pause or upgrade mechanism exists. These restrictions govern swaps and positions in this pool; token transfers and other markets are not restricted. SurfToken takes no constructor arguments.
